title: 第3章 苏欣儿

第一卷 败落的岳家第三章 苏欣儿 求收藏推荐

陆风是奇迹般的穿越了，可是一身的修为却半点不剩，现在跟一个普通人没有任何的差别，甚至比起普通人来说他的身体还要虚弱一些。

从吞噬来的灵魂中，陆风得知自己附身的这具躯体的主人叫做岳诚，因为被指腹为婚的未婚妻要求退婚，所以一时羞愧难当，直接就撞墙死了。

陆风再次缓缓的睁开了双眼，不知道是这具身体的缘故还是自己灵魂的缘故，陆风现在很虚弱。

“表哥，你感觉怎么样了？”陆风睁开眼睛，一张绝美的脸庞再次映入了眼帘。一头乌黑的秀发松散的披在肩后，高挺的鼻梁，小巧的嘴巴，那一双大眼睛嘿嘿透露，就像是会说话一般，精致的五官搭配出一张绝美的脸。

“表妹，我没事了。”陆风知道眼前的少女叫做苏欣儿，是岳诚的表妹，两人的关系一直不错。

“表哥，你以后不要再做傻事了好不好，你要是死了，那我怎么办。”苏欣儿眼眶中再次含着了泪水，这几天中她已经不知道流了多少泪。

看着苏欣儿的眼泪，陆风的心也有着一丝触动，修练千年，自己在华夏从小也是一个孤儿，后来朋友也一个个离自己而去，已经几百年没有人这么真心的关心自己了。

“放心，我不会再死了。”陆风忍不住微微的半坐起来，伸手轻轻的抚摸着苏欣儿的乌黑秀发。

“那好，你答应我的你一定要做到，不准再耍赖了。”苏欣儿听到岳诚的回答，这才破涕为笑，一双大眼睛高兴的看着岳诚。

看着苏欣儿的笑脸，陆风不禁心中微微一怔，这小妮子年纪不大，可看起来绝对是一个美人坯子，要是再过个三四年，还不知道能迷死多少的男人。

“嗯，我一定做到，你先出去好吗，我想好好的休息一下。”陆风微微的看着苏欣儿，从岳诚残余的灵魂中他得到了岳诚所有的记忆，他需要时间来好好消化。

“那好，我明天再来看你。”苏欣儿回道，随即站起身来往房外走去。

陆风这才看清楚苏欣儿的身材，没想到苏欣儿年纪不大，身材却凹凸有致勾勒出一条诱人的弧线。身穿一袭绿衣，从脸上就看得出来全身的肌肤也是白如雪滑如脂。胸前一对酥胸在绿衣的下微微凸耸，看起来发育的不错，腰如细柳，翘臀浑圆而挺拔，一双修长的玉腿高挑性感。

“嘎吱”看着苏欣儿走出房间并带上了房门，陆风这才回过神来，没想到这里的女子比起华夏来丝毫不差，想自己在华夏的时候，一生猎艳无数，所遇女子也全都是有着倾国倾城之姿。

陆风挣扎着爬起身来，盘膝坐在了床上。身体太虚弱了，需要好好的调息一下才行，自然的反应一缕灵魂力往手上探去，随即脸上露出一丝苦笑，自己只有一缕灵魂穿越，肉体早已经在华夏被天雷轰成了灰烬，手上的储物戒指自然也就不在了。本想找点丹药恢复一下身体，现在看来也不可能了。

苦笑之后，陆风也知道一切已经没办法改变，也只能接受这个事实。按照修练的功法，陆风只能靠体内的真气调息了，随即，陆风再次苦笑，体内一丝真气也没有，更别提运功调息了，这具躯体根本就是一个普通人的肉体，除了比起普通人来要结实强壮一点外，没有任何差别。

陆风不禁一下子呆了起来，千年的修为已经化作了乌有，老天开的玩笑也太大了吧。一下子从绝顶高手变成了普通人，换谁一下子也没办法接受。

许久，陆风才回过神来，双眼一沉，喃喃道：以后世上再也没有陆风，只有岳诚，肉体对我来说本就无所谓，前世陆风能一路站在巅峰之上，在这玄天大陆，岳诚也一样可以问鼎巅峰，老天，我会再回去的。

陆风想通了，自己虽然千年修为尽丧，但至少一缕灵魂不灭，五劫散仙的超级境界还在，有着这一层凭仗，自己一定能在最短的时间修练回当初的修为，到时候再问鼎仙魔界也不是难事。

想像归想像，陆风也知道事情也不会太容易，至少现在自己就遇到了不少的难关。首先自己现在修为尽丧，就连进入筑基期都不是件容易的事情。不过有着五劫散仙的超级境界，陆风也有了打算，这件事情要慢慢来才行，竟然重新来过，就一定要做到最好，不能让修为再出现任何副作用。

修真的修为境界一共有九层，分别是筑基期，开光期，胎息期，辟谷期，金丹期，元婴期，分神期，合体期，大乘期。每个层次又分为初期，中期和后期，最后就会进入渡劫期接受天劫，从而进入超级高手的散仙散魔行列，而前世陆风就是一个接受过五次天劫的超级散仙。

从岳诚的记忆中，陆风也知道玄天大陆现在是斗气和魔法横行的世界，岳诚就是天生无法修练斗气和魔法，才被从小指腹为婚的未婚妻要求退婚，所以才一时羞愧撞墙而死。

斗气的等级分为斗者，斗师，大斗师，斗灵，斗王，斗皇，斗宗，斗尊，斗圣九个等级，每个等级又分为一星到十星十个层次，之后就是进入斗帝的超级行列。

魔法的等级则是简单一些，只是分为一级魔法师到九级魔法师，之后就进入了圣魔导的超级行列。只是魔法却分为五个系，也叫做五系魔法，分别是风系魔法，水系魔法，火系魔法，土系魔法和雷电系魔法。

不过从岳诚的记忆中，陆风得知斗宗和七级魔法师这样的强者根本就找不到几个，另外陆风还得知，玄天大陆上还有一个超级的职业存在，他们的地位比起斗师和魔法师来还要高上一筹，那就是炼药师，因为成为炼药师的条件比起成为斗师和魔法师来还要苛刻的多，所以地位可想而知。

岳诚盘膝而坐，一身修为化作了灰烬，只好重新来过，先慢慢修练进入筑基期再说。前世修练的是混元真经，岳诚对混元真经早就滚瓜烂熟，按照混元真经的心法缓缓的修练起来。

Volume 1: The Decline of the Yue Family Chapter 3: Su Xin'er Please recommend for collection

Lu Feng miraculously traveled through time, but not a single bit of his cultivation was left. Now he is no different from an ordinary person. His body is even weaker than that of ordinary people.

From the devoured soul, Lu Feng learned that the owner of the body he was possessing was named Yue Cheng. Because his fiancée, whom he had married by fingertips, asked to break off the engagement, he was so ashamed that he hit a wall and died.

Lu Feng slowly opened his eyes again. He didn't know whether it was because of his body or his soul. Lu Feng was very weak now.

"Cousin, how are you feeling?" Lu Feng opened his eyes, and a beautiful face came into view again.She has jet black hair hanging loosely behind her shoulders, a tall nose, a small mouth, and a pair of big eyes that look like she can speak. Her exquisite facial features create a beautiful face.

"Cousin, I'm fine." Lu Feng knew that the girl in front of him was called Su Xin'er, and she was Yue Cheng's cousin. The two of them had always had a good relationship.

"Cousin, please don't do stupid things again. If you die, what will I do?" Su Xin'er had tears in her eyes again. She didn't know how many tears she had shed in the past few days.

Seeing Su Xin'er's tears, Lu Feng's heart was also touched. After thousands of years of training, he was also an orphan in China since he was a child. Later, his friends left him one by one. It has been hundreds of years since anyone cared about him so sincerely.

"Don't worry, I won't die again." Lu Feng couldn't help but sit up slightly, reaching out and gently stroking Su Xin'er's black hair.

"Okay, you must do what you promised me and don't cheat anymore." When Su Xin'er heard Yue Cheng's answer, she burst into laughter and looked at Yue Cheng happily with her big eyes.

Looking at Su Xin'er's smiling face, Lu Feng couldn't help but feel slightly startled. This little girl is not very old, but she looks like an absolute beauty. If only three or four years later, she would be able to charm many men to death.

"Well, I will definitely do it. Can you go out first? I want to have a good rest." Lu Feng looked at Su Xin'er slightly. He got all Yue Cheng's memories from Yue Cheng's remaining soul. He needed time to digest them.

"Okay, I'll come see you tomorrow." Su Xin'er replied, then stood up and walked out of the room.

Only then did Lu Feng see Su Xin'er's figure clearly. Unexpectedly, Su Xin'er was not very old, but her figure was well-proportioned and outlined an alluring arc.Wearing a green dress, it can be seen from his face that the skin all over his body is as white as snow and as smooth as fat.A pair of breasts are slightly bulging under the green clothes. They look well developed. Her waist is as thin as a willow, her buttocks are round and straight, and her slender legs are tall and sexy.

"Crunch" Seeing Su Xin'er walk out of the room and close the door, Lu Feng came back to his senses. He didn't expect that the women here were no worse than those in China. He thought that when he was in China, he had hunted countless beauties in his life, and all the women he met had the beauty of a country.

Lu Feng struggled to get up and sat cross-legged on the bed.His body was too weak and he needed to adjust his breathing properly. As a natural reaction, a ray of soul power reached his hand, and then a wry smile appeared on his face. He only had a ray of soul to travel through. His body had already been blasted to ashes by thunder in China, and the storage ring on his hand was naturally gone.I originally wanted to find some elixirs to restore my health, but it seems impossible now.

After smiling bitterly, Lu Feng knew that nothing could be changed and could only accept this fact.According to the training techniques, Lu Feng could only rely on the Qi in his body to adjust his breath. Then, Lu Feng smiled bitterly again. There was no Qi in his body, let alone the Qi to adjust his breath. This body was basically that of an ordinary person. Apart from being a little stronger and stronger than ordinary people, there was no difference.

Lu Feng couldn't help but froze for a moment. Thousands of years of cultivation had been reduced to nothing. God must be playing a big joke.He suddenly changed from a top expert to an ordinary person, and no one else would be able to accept it all of a sudden.

After a long time, Lu Feng came back to his senses, his eyes sank, and he murmured: From now on, there will be no Lu Feng in the world, only Yue Cheng. My body doesn't matter to me. In my previous life, Lu Feng could stand at the top all the way. In this Xuantian Continent, Yue Cheng can also reach the top. God, I will go back again.

Lu Feng figured out that although he had lost his thousand years of cultivation, at least a ray of his soul was immortal, and the super realm of the Five Tribulations Loose Immortal was still there. With this level of support, he would definitely be able to return to his original cultivation level in the shortest time, and it would not be difficult to aspire to the world of immortals and demons.

Just imagine, Lu Feng also knows that things will not be easy, at least now he has encountered a lot of difficulties.First of all, I am now at the end of my cultivation, and it is not easy to even enter the foundation building stage.However, with the super realm of Five Tribulations Loose Immortal, Lu Feng also had a plan. He had to take his time on this matter. If he had to start over, he must do his best and not let his cultivation have any side effects.

There are nine levels of cultivation in total, namely the foundation building stage, the enlightenment stage, the fetal breath stage, the bigu stage, the golden elixir stage, the Yuan Ying stage, the distraction stage, the integration stage, and the Mahayana stage.Each level is divided into the early stage, the middle stage and the late stage. Finally, it will enter the tribulation stage and accept the heavenly tribulation, thereby entering the ranks of super masters of loose immortals and demons. In his previous life, Lu Feng was a super loose immortal who had received five heavenly tribulations.

From Yue Cheng's memories, Lu Feng also knew that Xuantian Continent was now a world where fighting spirit and magic were rampant. Yue Cheng was born unable to practice fighting spirit and magic, so he was asked to break off the engagement by his fiancée who was married from his little fingertip, so he hit the wall and died out of shame.

The levels of Dou Qi are divided into nine levels: Dou Zhe, Dou Master, Great Dou Master, Dou Ling, Dou King, Dou Emperor, Dou Zong, Dou Zun, and Dou Sheng. Each level is further divided into ten levels from one star to ten stars. After that, you can enter the super ranks of Dou Emperor.

The levels of magic are simpler, ranging from first-level magicians to ninth-level magicians, and then they enter the super ranks of holy magicians.But magic is divided into five systems, also called five systems of magic, namely wind magic, water magic, fire magic, earth magic and thunder and lightning magic.

However, from Yue Cheng's memory, Lu Feng learned that there were not many powerful people like Douzong and seventh-level magicians at all. In addition, Lu Feng also learned that there was a super profession on Xuantian Continent. Their status was even higher than that of Dou Masters and Magicians, and that was Alchemists. Because the conditions for becoming an Alchemist were much more stringent than those of Dou Masters and Magicians, one could imagine their status.

Yue Cheng sat cross-legged, his cultivation turned into ashes, and he had to start over, slowly entering the foundation building stage.In his previous life, he practiced the Hunyuan Sutra. Yue Cheng had long been familiar with the Hunyuan Sutra and slowly began to practice according to the mentality of the Hunyuan Sutra.
